title: The Fleet That History Forgot: Rajendra Chola I's Campaigns Against Srivijaya
description: Rajendra Chola I's 1025 CE naval raid on Srivijaya, and why the popular blue-water navy, total-conquest, and royal-marriage version of the story doesn't survive contact with the inscriptions.

title: The Mahabharata War: A Meta-Analysis of Astronomical Dating Claims
description: Nineteen proposed dates for the Mahabharata war, spanning 5561 BCE to 900 BCE, scored against a shared evidentiary rubric.

title: In Silico Identification of Horizontal Gene Transfer: Tracking blaNDM-1 Across Multi-Species Gut Reservoirs
description: A comparative genomics study tracing the carbapenem-resistance gene blaNDM-1 as it hops between E. coli and Shigella within the human gut.

title: The Navy Nobody Talks About: Rajendra Chola's War Across the Sea
description: A fleet of repurposed merchant ships, a captured king, and a story that's been oversold in almost every retelling since.

title: The Iron Gap: Why More Than Half of Indian Women Are Anaemic, and Why It Got Worse
description: NFHS-5 found 57 percent of Indian women anaemic, up from 53 percent five years earlier, despite a national program built specifically to bring the number down.

title: Half of India's Pregnancies Are Now High-Risk
description: NFHS data shows nearly half of pregnancies in India now classified high-risk, driven by rising metabolic disease and answered, unevenly, with surgery.

title: Mycoremediation of Textile Dye Effluent in India: A Scoping Review of the Gap Between Laboratory Evidence and Field Deployment
description: Fungal enzymes can break down the azo dyes that make Indian textile effluent so persistent. Almost none of that research has left the lab bench for the dyeing clusters producing the pollution.
